description: Interactive landing/marketing page as new frontend route showcasing product value proposition, pipeline visualization, key features, live demo CTA, and integration with existing dashboard. Independent from existing dashboard pages but shares styling.
steps: Create apps/web/src/pages/Landing.tsx as new page component. Import lucide-react icons: Sparkles, Shield, Zap, GitPullRequest, Terminal, Boxes, TrendingUp, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, ExternalLink. Use existing CSS custom properties from apps/web/src/App.css and index.css. Do NOT create new CSS files.

Build hero section with gradient background matching Dashboard.tsx pattern (linear-gradient with rgba indigo/cyan hues, decorative blob elements with radial-gradient). Headline: 'Self-Maintaining APIs. Zero Manual Migrations.' Subheadline: 'Autonomous change detection, bounded code generation, sandbox validation, and gated Draft PRs. Built for engineering teams.' Two CTAs: 'Launch Live Demo' (primary button navigating to dashboard) and 'View GitHub' (secondary button linking to https://github.com/rizzzabh-06/self-maintaining-apis).

Add 'How It Works' section with 7-step visual pipeline matching PIPELINE_STEPS from Dashboard.tsx. Use horizontal scroll container with glass-panel cards for each step. Include step icons, titles, and 1-sentence descriptions. Steps: 1) Provider Webhook (Zap icon, 'FakePay releases v2.0.0'), 2) Change Engine (Terminal, 'AST-based OpenAPI diff'), 3) Repo Scanner (Boxes, '4-tier TypeScript discovery'), 4) Impact Analysis (TrendingUp, 'Trace affected call sites'), 5) Migration Planner (GitPullRequest, 'Deterministic recipe or LLM'), 6) Sandbox Validation (Shield, 'Isolated build & tests'), 7) Draft PR (CheckCircle2, 'Human-gated review').

Add 'Key Features' section with 4 feature cards in 2x2 grid. Each card: glass-panel style, icon, title, 2-sentence description. Features: 1) 'Deterministic First' (Zap icon, 'AST-verified string replacement recipes. Gemini LLM only for unseen patterns.'), 2) 'Strict Safety' (Shield icon, 'Draft PR invariant. Zero auto-merge. Isolated sandbox validation.'), 3) 'Deep Discovery' (Terminal icon, '4-tier scanner: package.json, base URLs, client methods, call sites.'), 4) 'Production Ready' (CheckCircle2 icon, 'Neon Postgres. 88 passing tests. TypeScript + Python.').

Add 'Tech Stack' section with badge-style pills in horizontal flex wrap. Include badges for: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Neon Postgres, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Google Gemini 2.5, React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tree-sitter AST, Pytest, Vitest. Use existing badge CSS classes from Dashboard (badge, badge-ts, badge-py, badge-success, etc.). Match styling to metric cards in Dashboard.

Add 'Live Demo' CTA section near bottom. Large centered card with purple/indigo gradient background. Text: 'Ready to see it in action?' Button: 'Launch Interactive Demo' navigating to dashboard tab. Secondary button: 'Watch Video Walkthrough' (links to #video placeholder for FEAT-003).

Add footer section matching existing App.tsx footer: dark background, border-top, centered text. Include: 'Self-Maintaining API Agent • Neon Postgres • Gemini LLM • Strict Draft PR Invariant'. Link to GitHub repo. Connection status indicator matching App.tsx pattern (green dot if backend is reachable).

Integrate Landing page into App.tsx: Add Landing import, add landing state case in activeTab switch, add 'Home' navigation item to Navbar.tsx (new prop: showHomeLink). Default activeTab to 'landing' for first-time visitors, 'dashboard' for returning (use localStorage flag). Add transition animation (fade-in) when switching to landing.

Update apps/web/src/components/Navbar.tsx to include optional 'Home' link at far left when showHomeLink prop is true. Link text: 'Home' with house icon from lucide-react. Active state styling matches other nav items. Only show if not already on landing page.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to http://localhost:5173 displays the landing page by default on first visit
Hero section displays headline, subheadline, and two functional CTA buttons
How It Works pipeline section renders all 7 steps with icons and descriptions in scrollable container
Key Features grid displays all 4 feature cards with glass-panel styling
Tech Stack badges render in flex wrap and match existing Dashboard badge styles
Clicking 'Launch Live Demo' navigates to the dashboard tab and hides landing page
Clicking 'View GitHub' opens https://github.com/rizzzabh-06/self-maintaining-apis in new tab
Landing page styling is consistent with Dashboard: same color palette, glass-panel effects, animations
Footer connection indicator correctly shows green dot when backend at :8000 is reachable
Navbar 'Home' link appears and correctly navigates back to landing page
verification: npm run dev in apps/web/, navigate to http://localhost:5173, landing page renders without console errors
Click 'Launch Live Demo' button, URL does not change but dashboard content replaces landing
Click Navbar 'Home' link, landing page reappears
Click 'View GitHub' button, new tab opens to correct GitHub URL
Inspect element on hero section, verify linear-gradient background CSS is applied
Resize browser to mobile width, verify pipeline steps remain horizontally scrollable
Backend running on :8000, verify footer green dot is visible and pulsing
